data.name: Heroes and Overlord
data.detailed_description:
This game combines tower defense and auto-chess gameplay.
In the game, you will experience four major factions: Humans, Vampires, Demons, and Orcs.
Each race features unique troops, heroes, buildings, and tactical styles.

【Dual-Core Gameplay: A Strategic Experience of Both Offense and Defense】
Offensive Mode (Auto-Chess Conquest): Assemble your expedition lineup. Once units are placed, they will automatically engage in battle. You need to anticipate the flow of combat and timely activate skills to intervene, breaking through enemy defenses.

Defensive Mode (Tower Defense Chess): On a chessboard-like fortress map, meticulously arrange defensive towers, barracks, and heroes. Study enemy attack routes and troop types to strategically deploy defenses, facing increasingly fierce waves of attacks.

【Deep Progression and Customization Systems】
Talent Tree System: Unlock unique talents for your troops, heroes, and even defensive structures to shape your distinct combat style.

Equipment Crafting System: Gather materials to instantly synthesize weapons, armor, and artifacts on the battlefield, significantly enhancing the capabilities of key units.

Ultimate Weapon—Titan: Accumulate resources to summon a legendary Titan unit unique to your race. These colossal beings will serve as mobile fortresses, providing overwhelming power on both offense and defense.

【Conquest and Rivalry: An Endless War】
Start from a small piece of territory and gradually expand your empire’s domain.
Challenge fortresses of global players to test your offensive strategies.
Build your personal impregnable defense line to face conquerors from around the world.
The war has already begun. Are you ready?
